questions.question: An incident note reads: an analyst assembles a profile of a company from discoverable technical and public data. Select the MOST appropriate classification.

options.A: Competitive intelligence
options.B: Search-engine reconnaissance
options.C: Footprinting
options.D: Open-source intelligence

questions.explanation: This is an example of footprinting: an analyst assembles a profile of a company from discoverable technical and public data. A relevant security consideration is to minimize unnecessary public exposure of organizational details.

questions.question: Which guidance BEST addresses the key issue associated with Footprinting?

options.A: Distinguish lawful business research from intrusive collection
options.B: Strip unneeded document metadata before public release
options.C: Minimize unnecessary public exposure of organizational details
options.D: Evaluate the reliability and context of publicly obtained information

questions.explanation: The best recommendation for footprinting is to minimize unnecessary public exposure of organizational details; this directly addresses the issue described by the concept.
